text:
### Is there any fee involved for Online updation of Demographics details?
![](https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/static/media/ArrowDown.a5229ab197c918ede75c7ae811502301.svg)
Yes, for online update of demographic information you have to pay Rs. 75/- (including GST).
